messages_orig.content:
Write the following referral letter:

17-year-old runner presents complaining of a “bad knee.” She’s a member of my high school track team. No imaging was done, and I don’t know how or when the pain started. There’s no exam or other details yet. Please draft a referral to the sports medicine clinic so she can be evaluated.
